page.overview:
Who is Elijah?

Elijah is a high profile underworld informant and go-to representative of Mad Gear, and with many ties to subordinate groups and allies of the gang. Due to his no nonsense demeanor and sense of respect, he is widely respected and held as trustworthy.

He used to keep a long glam rock hairstyle, but moved on to others when the products he used went out of the market. Currently Elijah is sporting a fashionable goatee and shorter haircut, after being inspired by a recent superhero movie. He still lives with and takes care of his mother, who lives downtown in the city. Though they may quarrel at times, he still loves her.

Elijah is muscular and slow and can deal heavy damage.
